# West Coast KBP

> West Coast KBP is a construction platform for ADU (accessory dwelling unit)
> and residential construction in the Sacramento region of California:
> Roseville, Rocklin, Lincoln, Folsom, Granite Bay, El Dorado Hills, Citrus
> Heights, and nearby areas. Services: ADU construction, garage conversions,
> residential general construction, and GC/subcontract coordination.

The platform organizes construction work as controlled project objects with
visible scope, state, approvals, evidence, and next actions. The owner
personally reviews every commitment before it is made. The current site is a
public platform preview: it does not collect, submit, store, or track visitor
information, and it makes no pricing, schedule, permit, or feasibility claims —
those require individual review and official source verification.

## Pages

- [Home](https://westcoastkbp.com/): platform overview, services, process,
  and preview of the project-control approach.
